Nick soon learns that these coins have an unsettling effect on whoever possesses them, as Hank and Captain Renard begin to exhibit unusual behaviour. Meanwhile, a mysterious old friend of Aunt Marie's comes to Nick with information about his family and what led to his parent's death.

Mitsy may appear to be normal but there is something terribly wrong. The rescue kitten is struggling to walk. Andrew Marchevsky is left with no other option but to operate.

Emotions are running high at the clinic. Watch as Chris reunites with Poppy to search for a perfect foster home, helps a donkey facing a drastically diminished quality of life, and has his heart stolen by a homeless cat.

Join Chris at Victoria’s Kyabram Vet Clinic, where he helps a pregnant cow survive a difficult labor and saves a Maltese terrier’s unborn pups. Back in Sydney, Tim tries to assist a magnificent peregrine falcon that’s been grounded.

Harriet the Bearded Dragon is a much loved resident of the local Fauna Park. Her Keeper Hannah is concerned about a lump that has suddenly appeared on the dragon's leg. The worry is that it could be cancer.

At the Australian reptile park, Operations Manager Tim Faulkner is responding to an in-house emergency. Cameron the Cormorant has swallowed a mystery object Tim needs to remove the object urgently or Cameron may choke to death.
A tense night as Chris fights to save a policeman's poisoned pet, rescues a malnourished penguin that washed up onshore and operates on a young pup with a disintegrating leg.

Chris confronts a bizarre and shocking act of cruelty as a 12-year-old cat is deliberately dumped in the Bondi surf and left to die. There's also a depressed parrot caught in a bizarre love triangle, and can Lisa help a beautiful Samoyed survive a killer tick bite?

A groundbreaking operation is happening at the Bondi clinic: Elroy, the out-of-control bulldog is being desexed, and Chris is about to give him the very latest fake silicone testicles direct from the United States. Lisa hopes a blood transfusion can save a senior citizen. There are some very different patients including a sick owl spreading some nasty bugs and a turtle that's wandered way off track.

On this episode you will lose your heart to a brave golden retriever and her devoted owner. Rosie has severely deformed legs and only major surgery can save her life. How will owner Angus find the money and will the operation work? Chris also introduces us to one of Bondi's most delightful dog-loving eccentrics, and a cutting-edge solution for a record-breaking goat.
Dr Chris desperately fights to save the life of an innocent hit and run victim. Lisa helps little Zoe battle a poisonous snake bite. And, a lorikeet learns to fly again.

A much-loved Labrador is in trouble after a head on collision with a car and Lisa is in a race against time to find the cause of a mystery illness that is threatening the life of a five-month-old kitten. As well, Chris heads to the bush and gets called out to help with a difficult birth.

It's an unforgettable story as Chris takes home a fragile baby kangaroo with the odds against him: will the joey make it without his mum? Plus, a helping hand for a puppy with a life-threatening problem. And Chris confronts his archenemy: a chihuahua with a mean streak.
Follow Chris behind bars and meet three beautiful pups who are changing prisoners' lives. Lisa struggles to save the life of a pregnant beagle. And, a bunny brings the Bondi vet to tears.

“American Greed” goes inside the dark side of the American Dream - where money seduces, power corrupts, and smooth criminals will stop at nothing to get rich.

Sarah is aware of the growing tension between Wilfred and Adam and calls a meeting to ease the tension.
Jim and Cheryl attempt to plan for some romantic time alone, but when the kids demand all of her attention, Jim plans to meet Cheryl for a tryst in the airport lounge.

Without Cheryl's knowledge, and while she is still in Florida, Jim seizes the opportunity to transform the garage into a cigar lounge and donates all of the kids' old furniture and clothes to charity.

Jim is forced to host Gracie's doll themed birthday party while a pregnant Cheryl is on bed rest. But when Gracie tells Jim she only agreed to a doll party to please Cheryl, Jim turns a girly tea party into a wild squirt gun fight.
When Doug and Carrie go on vacation to celebrate their anniversary, they decide to take their friends Deacon and Kelly which turns out to be a big mistake.
It's double the havoc when Ray and Debra Barone come and visit Doug and Carrie.
Doug's ego gets busted when he gets checked out by a waitress.
Jake is called upon to negotiate a hostage situation with a jewel thief, only to discover that the culprit seems to be a familiar face.

Jake embarks on an all-night long interrogation in order to elicit a confession out of a suspect. But when Captain Holt skips the opera in order to stay back and help, the two cops clash over how to get him to talk.
Jake surprises Amy with an investigation into a string of arsons connected to her favourite crossword puzzle author, Vin Stermley.

The rare one-horned rhinoceros is being poached in Kaziranga National Park. Herds of elephants are on the move and a new born baby elephant has lost its mother. People who live in Kaziranga risk their lives to make sure the wild animals stay safe, including the tigers that also roam the park.

The man who saved the last colony of Guizhou golden monkeys is getting old. He must pass responsibility on to the next in line. But will his successor be able to keep the monkeys safe? And a Buddhist master needs to replenish her spirit on the peak of a sacred mountain but she is afraid of heights!

Nature has created rare beauty here on Kyushu, one of the islands of Japan. But within recent memory, in 1991, there was a devastating volcanic eruption. This is the story of how people live in the shadow of destruction, under the volcanoes of Japan.

One of the world's most diverse reef systems off the coast of Borneo has just become protected - Tun Sakaran Marine Park. It's a magical paradise where an ancient volcano once erupted. Hundreds of species of corals and fish live here -- and so do many people who rely on the sea to survive.

Khao Sok National Park is framed by karst sandstone formations. Mighty ghost-like shaped rocks mark the shores of lake Khao Sok, a huge reservoir on which only a very few fishermen are permitted to live. Ancient caves are found in the watery depths and in the mountainous heights.

p.d: Equipping Pastors, group leaders & church members with biblical truth and tools to heal themselves and take healing to a wounded world.

p.t: Gold Rush: Dave Turin's Lost Mine
p.d: The team divides in the remote Idaho Rockies. Then, already behind schedule, Dave is forced to make a bet that can make or break the season.
The Poseidon Crew unearth a once in a lifetime nugget at Catto's Paddock. Jacqui Buzetti braves the wild Northern Territory with a new mining partner.
Spotting smoke on a distant shore, a team pushes to find another camp. The jungle trek has Mandy at her breaking point. Dani and Jarrell's clashing survival styles spark a blowout fight.
Ed starts his journey in a tidal mangrove system in Madagascar. As the waters race in, he struggles to reach a fishing village in 10 days.
The NASA tapes that recorded the Apollo 11 moon landing are missing. Experts examine whether their disappearance is part of a cover-up.

The Raney family members work with one another to fabricate their first self-automated homestead, which is fully functional on its own, in the wilderness of Alaska while firefighters Kim and Casey Boespflug are away on duty.
Andrew goes deeper, asking a bold question: if the drug war is real, then why are the cartels winning? His investigation uncovers shocking insights.
Torrential downpours hammer the survivalists as soon as they're dropped into the Georgia rainforest.
A pair of survivalists pushing 50 and a pair in their early 20s take on the Sonoran Desert. They are tested by mountain lions, gila monsters and unrelenting heat.
Two survivalists are tested in the Colorado Rocky Mountains. They face hailstorms and hypothermic conditions during their 21-day challenge.

After surviving a nearly fatal car crash, an impulsive adventurer is paired with a cautious archaeologist in the Texas desert. Stalked by mountain lions and tarantulas, this odd couple must work together to endure scorching days and frigid nights.

Manufacturers give a behind-the-scenes look at the chart-topping, six-string star of rock and roll; the motorsports secrets to racing around the clock with a road car turned endurance racer; the popular seafood spread made from cod roe.
Skin and Jay hunt for their quota in a secret abalone bed close to a recent shark attack, and Bucky goes to Hong Kong in search of new buyers and better prices.
Stan gets a surprise visit from an old friend and the reunion sparks opportunity for a risky mining operation. Charlie tests his son Bob's recovery with an epic hunt.
Tony sets his sights on a $3.5-million monster dozer. Dave hunts for a claim with his new Mad Max prospecting machine. Rick tests a pioneering drilling method.

p.t: Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull
p.d: A rebellious young man brings Indiana Jones an indecipherable coded message, and thus Indy finds himself chasing a mysterious crystal skull artefact in South America.

Four years after her last encounter with Michael Myers, Laurie Strode finally decides to liberate herself and embrace life. However, a local murder unleashes a cascade of violence and terror that forces her to confront the evil she can't control.

In the year 2154, the very wealthy live on the space station Elysium while the vast majority lives on an overpopulated Earth. A man takes on a mission to equalise the situation between these two classes.
Four-wheeled felon Dominic Toretto is back behind the wheel, teaming up with the FBI's Brian O'Conner to battle a brutal drug gang.

Jurassic World, a fully functional dinosaur park that sees 20,000 visitors a year, is the realisation of owner John Hammond's dreams. However, scientists may have gone too far in creating a hybrid dinosaur, which escapes and terrorises the park.

Members of an odd police force chase monstrous spirits who try to escape their final judgment by hiding among the living. When the lawmen uncover a plot that could end all life, they must restore the cosmic balance.

Four years after the destruction of Isla Nublar, dinosaurs now live and hunt alongside humans all over the world. This fragile balance will reshape the future and determine whether human beings are to remain the apex predators.
A highly respected CIA agent resolves to go on the run after a defector accuses her of being a spy for the Russians.

A fast-talking cop trails his best friend's killer from the alleys of Detroit to the posh galleries of Beverly Hills.
In a barrage of fists, gunfire and squealing tires, an enraged man must save his wife and son from a dangerous adversary, and ensure that no one will underestimate him again.

William Shakespeare and his wife, Agnes, celebrate the birth of their son, Hamnet. However, when tragedy strikes and Hamnet dies at a young age, it inspires Shakespeare to write his timeless masterpiece "Hamlet.".
Two young men during World War I set out to record the lives, voices and music of their American countrymen.
When his beloved wife, Kathryn, is suspected of betraying the nation, intelligence agent George Woodhouse faces the ultimate test -- loyalty to his marriage or his country.
A socially awkward tween endures the ruthless hierarchy at a water polo camp, his anxiety spiralling into psychological turmoil over the summer.

Violet is a widowed mother who goes to a restaurant to meet Henry, her charming and handsome date. However, she soon receives phone messages from a mysterious, hooded figure who threatens to kill her young son and sister unless she kills Henry.
Follows two Brit police officers Thomas Wilkin and Geoffrey Morton in their hunt for charismatic poet and Zionist freedom fighter Avraham Stern, who was plotting to evict British authorities.
Supermodel Kate Moss embarks on a journey of self-discovery when acclaimed artist Lucian Freud offers to paint her portrait.
An NBA star, a corrupt cop, a female rap duo, teenage punks, neo-Nazis and a debt collector embark on a collision course in 1987 Oakland, Calif.
The true story of seasoned deep-sea divers who battle the raging elements to rescue a crewmate who's trapped hundreds of feet below the ocean's surface.

As the world's top assassins fight to the death in a ruthless underground tournament, a rogue crew has its own deadly agenda: survive the carnage, outplay the killers, and take down the mastermind behind it all.

A shark-obsessed serial killer holds Zephyr, a rebellious surfer, captive on his boat. Racing against time, she must figure out a way to escape before he carries out a ritualistic feeding to the sharks below.

Rickey, an energetic and free-spirited young man with a Peter Pan complex, convinces his long-time friend Glenn to hit pause on his blissful domestic life and embark on an impromptu road trip across California.

Iris finds her comfortable New York City life thrown into disarray after her closest friend and mentor bequeaths her a Great Dane named Apollo. Yet as Iris finds herself unexpectedly bonding with Apollo, she begins to come to terms with her past.

On the brink of losing her childhood home, a desperate woman agrees to date a wealthy couple's introverted and awkward 19-year-old son. However, he proves to be more of a challenge than she expected, and time is running out before she loses it all.

p.d: Weeks after becoming an item with dependable Mark Darcy, hapless Bridget gets cold feet and takes a new job alongside devious former boss Daniel.
Befuddled mum-to-be Bridget Jones must figure out which of the two men in her life is the father of her child.

p.t: Bridget Jones: Mad About the Boy
p.d: After jumping back into the dating pool, single mother Bridget Jones finds herself caught between a younger man and her son's science teacher.

At the end of the 19th century, a poor Irishman heads for the New World in the hope of becoming rich. He meets a wealthy and beautiful woman, and together they struggle before reaching their paradise in Oklahoma.
An ousted sports agent attempts to rebuild his career with the help of a loyal accountant and an egotistical athlete.
A year in the life of a neurotic thirty-something who resolves to take control of her life once and for all.

Sara and Jonathan meet by chance, but part when she says that if they are meant to be together, fate will find a way. Years later, destiny seems to conspire to rekindle their love.

A struggling matchmaker is hired by a king to find his son a suitable wife in time for a national celebration. As the clock ticks toward the deadline, the matchmaker finds him the perfect wife, only to realise she's fallen in love with him.

p.t: Sweet Revenge: A Hannah Swensen Mystery
p.d: As Hannah and Mike balance their personal lives and busy careers, a murder at a 24-hour gym complicates their wedding plans.
Three former college friends join forces to prove to their ex-husbands that hell hath no fury like a woman scorned.

Lt. Callie Jackson returns home after a military tour to find her late grandfather's barbecue joint is struggling, but she has a run-in with a TV director who teaches her that sometimes it's best to look forward instead of looking back.
A teen suffers the pain of adolescence as she longs for Mr Right while fending off the advances of the class clown.
When three best friends vow to get married within a year, each woman experiences her own difficulties getting to the altar.

p.t: Indiana Jones And The Last Crusade
p.d: In this third instalment of the great adventure saga, Indy is on a treacherous quest for the Holy Grail, complicated by a sexy woman with a fatal flaw: she's a Nazi agent.
Two young men in World War I set out to capture the lives, voices and music of their fellow American soldiers.
A sports agent suddenly discovers his scruples and promptly loses his job. But with the help of one loyal colleague and one outrageous client, he learns that loving well is the best revenge.
A heartbroken pop star spontaneously weds a stranger from the audience while live on stage, but their sham marriage turns into a real romance.
Four years after the destruction of Isla Nublar, Biosyn operatives attempt to track down Maisie Lockwood, while Dr Ellie Sattler investigates a genetically engineered swarm of giant insects.
Ethan Hunt must bring down a ruthless villain and rescue his fiancee.
After 45 years, the most revered horror franchise in film history reaches its terrifying conclusion as Laurie Strode faces off for the last time against the embodiment of evil, Michael Myers.
A slick, young Navy lawyer is assigned to investigate a murder case in which two Marines killed a fellow enlisted man, and no one's talking.
The true meaning of family gets tested like never before as Dom Toretto takes the team on a worldwide ride with high-stakes action, old friends and a surprising new foe.
About to lose her home, Maddie finds an job listing: parents looking for someone to bring their introverted 19-year-old son out of his shell before college. She has one summer to make him a man.
Things are really hoppin' at Rydell High when Danny discovers the object of his summer fling, Sandy, has moved to town and enrolled in his school.
The Bad Guys are the most notorious criminals in the world, pulling off a lifetime of legendary heists, but can the gang of misfits pull off their biggest job yet - going good?

p.t: The Adventures of Danny and the Dingo: Vans Tahoe Cup
p.d: S1 E7The gang meets up with wildcard winner, Chaz Chaffee, at the water park to officially give him his ticket to Grenade Games as well as try out indoor surfing. With nothing but candy and pizza rolls for food, the boys make the long journey from Raging Buffalo to Tahoe in time for one of snowboarding's biggest contest. After Lucas wins the rail jam he becomes extremely confident and bets Danny $1500 he can beat him at the Slope style contest. Danny takes things to the next level when he attempts an Alley-oop backside 720 to a cab 1080 at the Super pipe which has never been done in competition before. The boy's wrap-up the Tahoe Cup and head back to Mammoth where they will prepare for Grenades Games.  There someone will become the next Grenade team rider.

p.t: The Adventures of Danny and the Dingo: A New Grenade Team Rider!
p.d: S1 E8The entire Grenade family meets at their headquarters in Portland, OR. After a quick skate session everyone boards the bus for Snoqualmie to get the Grenade Games underway. As the Grenade crew arrives and party in the hotel bar through the night, the 4 local winners and wild card, Chaz, begin arriving the next morning at the airport.  They're greeted by Dingo who gets them checked into their hotel rooms.  Day one of Grenade Games starts with Danny and Dingo doing a morning radio show.  When they return to the hill, they are given bad news.  Due to excessive partying at the hotel the night before everyone is being kicked out.  After showing very little concern for the hotel, the first day of Grenade games goes off with nontraditional Snowboard contest events such as: Chinese Eyed Downhill, Dunk the Dingo and The Bull Ride. On day two the five finalists are hit with a curve ball when Danny and Dingo decide to hold a qualifying round for the locals of Snoqualmie. Bennie Heinrich becomes the 6th competitor fighting for a spot on the Grenade amateur team. After a long deliberation everyone agrees on the winner Bennie and heads to the final party to celebrate with a performance from Fat Joe.
S1 E13We follow Lincoln as he trains for Tony Hawk's Boom Boom Huck Jam tour and competes in the Vans Triple Crown.
S4 E9Professional skateboarder Nilton Neves takes us to his childhood skate spots in his hometown of Sao Paulo, Brazil then returns to his current residence of San Francisco to skate the local spots.

p.t: Drive Thru - Caribbean - Dolphins, Sharks, and Rastas
p.d: S4 E4The last day in Jamaica and the guys need to make the most of their time. Billy explains surfing in Jamaica to the crew and the outlook for the future. One last surf goes down at the lighthouse with the whole camp and a bunch of Red Stripes. Benji continues his streak of getting hurt just in time to pet some sharks and ride some dolphins. Finally, Billy and the camp bid farewell to the crew.

Jason along with daughter Haily, visit a house to investigate child ghosts who occasionally bounce balls and are heard walking back and forth on the third floor. Jason allows Haily to take the lead on her first investigation, as he believes that child ghosts are more apt to make contact with younger females. The group just might have thought correctly after Haily hears whispering voices.
The TAPS team is the first paranormal team to ever investigate the famed Friar's Club in New York City. Next, the team travels to the Main Street Armory in Rochester, New York.
Ghost Hunters, the team heads to Rapids Theater in Niagara Falls, New York where a lonely actress hanged herself backstage. The staff believes her spirit has never left and is haunting the theater.

Special guest investigator Meredith Vieira joins the TAPS team, as they investigate Sailors' Snug Harbor in Staten Island, New York. Once a retirement home to weathered seaman, it's now home to the spirit of a murdered matron.

TAPS is called out to Jefferson City, Missouri, to investigate the notorious Missouri State Penitentiary. A prison that was once named one of the most violent prisons in America. Riots, stabbings and executions left thousands dead over the years -- resulting in an abandoned prison full of ghostly inmates.
TAPS heads back to the fan favorite; Waverly Hills Sanatorium in Louisville, Kentucky, an abandoned tuberculosis hospital haunted by its former patients and staff.
The team visits Kentucky to probe a distillery where the ghost of a colonel may lurk and to investigate a nightclub with a grim past.

TAPS is called out to Hartford, CT to Elks Lodge, the oldest and largest secret fraternal organizations in the country. Elks Lodge #19 is shrouded in mystery and tragedy with a gruesome death hanging over its head....and decades of paranormal activity.
TAPS travels to “Christmas City” to investigate hauntings believed to be caused by two kids trapped in time.
TAPS is investigating a haunted amusement park that has a restless spirit yearning to stay on the rides. Later, a family is frightened in their home and call on the Ghost Hunters for help.

Tonight the Ghost Hunters visit a hotel haunted by the spirit of a suicide victim, and later come to the rescue of a couple that is ready to leave their home because the paranormal activity is too much to handle. Don't move! Call the Ghost Hunters!

TAPS investigates the Hales Bar Dam And Marina in Guild, TN, where for the first time, TAPS will take their cameras underwater to search a graveyard that was flooded when the dam broke. Built on former Cherokee land, the dam is said to be cursed by a fallen Indian Chief.

TAPS heads to Red Boiling Springs, Tennessee, where the Thomas House Bed and Breakfast apparently has guests that don't want to leave. Leave this realm, that is. Built in 1890 by the Coyd family, many members of the family died in the house and are causing the current owners, the Cole family, great concern. The Cole family now own the building and want to know what exactly is haunting their home and business, and what can they do?

TAPS travels to Virginia in order to investigate Major Graham Mansion, a historical location that has seen hangings, madness and murder and is thought to be haunted by spirits that include Major Graham's wife and a small girl who was buried nearby.

TAPS heads to Providence City Hall to investigate claims that a former mayor is haunting the building. The team then travels to Farmington, NY to help a couple whose 4-year-old grandson is traumatized by spirits in their historic house.

Since 1970 the Hour of Power has been reaching viewers from around the world. Originally founded by Dr Robert H Schuller, the program became the most-watched religious program in the world, reaching 17 million viewers. Now under the leadership of Bobby Schuller, Dr Schuller’s grandson. The congregation worships at Shepherd’s Grove Church in Garden Grove, CA. The program aims to provide spiritual principles and practices that can help people, as they become happy students of Jesus and live a life of meaning. To learn more about who they are in Christ through the process of formation, to belong to his family of believers and become a part of the community and to heal as they are loved and then love and help heal others through mission. Jesus Christ ushered in the Kingdom of God into our world through His death and resurrection. He invites everyone to be a part of this amazing movement by trusting and following Him. There is no fuller, richer life than the one that is lived in Christ.
We like to call it 'soul food'. LIFE TV uses creative illustration, real life stories and biblical teaching to encourage and help viewers discover a greater purpose to their lives.

There is more to you than meets the eye. You are a spirit being. You have a soul. You live in a physical body In this encouraging message, Pastor Bayless walks through three remarkable stories from Mark chapter 5 that reveal how Jesus brings freedom to the whole person. You’ll see how Christ delivers an oppressed soul, heals a broken body, and even restores life where all hope seemed lost. These stories remind us that no situation is beyond the reach of God’s power. Discover how coming to the feet of Jesus can change everything as you listen today.
It’s hard to face the truth about yourself. Today, Joyce shares some of the benefits of taking responsibility for your actions in order to grow in your relationship with Christ.

Katherine Ruonala shares a practical message of love and hope to the nations. Reaching across denominational walls, her ministry is used to spread the fires of revival and ignite a fresh passion in the hearts of believers to go deeper in their relationship with God. Katherine carries a strong prophetic and miracle anointing with many experiencing instant healing in her meetings.

p.t: Harriet Tubman: They Called Her Moses
p.d: Harriet Tubman is a familiar and revered name in American history. But many are unfamiliar with the details of her remarkable story, the depth of her character, and the inner motivations that drove her.

p.t: Turning Point With Dr. David Jeremiah
p.d: In this interview Dr. David Jeremiah and Sheila Walsh discuss the enemies we face and the weapons we have as we fight, as well as the courage and strength God gives us while we battle.

Vietnam. 1989. Fourteen years after the end of the war. When Irish woman Christina Noble flies into Ho Chi Minh City formerly Saigon, she leaves behind an extraordinary life story. But the best is yet to come. Christina lands in a country that she wouldnt be able to show you on a map. With a few dollars, a dream and her own hard won courage, she is about to change everything. For hundreds of thousands of people. Forever. NOBLE is the inspirational true story of a woman who believes that it only takes one person to make a difference. And of how she is proved right.

A team of experienced disaster response volunteers, powered by mateship and determination, ride bicycles across the Simpson Desert to raise money for Australian charity Global Care, while lockdowns threaten to derail their adventure. In 2021, Global Care Australia celebrated their 25 years of service undertaking projects for disaster relief and community resilience, in over 94 locations across Australia. Produced and directed by award-winning filmmaker Jude Kalman of Little Drum Pictures during the 2021 and 2022 COVID pandemic, travel restrictions limited the filming of Global Care initiatives to Queensland locations. It is a story of resilience when the going gets tough; mates helping mates across the harsh landscape of the Simpson desert and in communities throughout Australia.

p.t: Hedgerow Hell: The Fury of Normandy - 1944
p.d: In July of 1944, at the height of World War II in Europe, Americans stormed the beaches of Normandy. Everyone thought it would be a relatively easy move into enemy territory and past Adolph Hitler's Nazi forces. They were wrong. It took nearly two months to advance only 50 kilometers into the French countryside. Now, commanders and historians study the events of Normandy to improve modern tactics.

This episode starts with the unique salt from Reyjanes in the Westfjords of Iceland, revealing the perfect harmony between sweet and salty in nature. The combination of saltiness and sweetness offers diners a new understanding of the sensory experience of natual balance. In Turpan, Xinjiang, the people's deep love for grapes reflects a pursuit of the most primitive flavors, emphasizing the charm of natural ingredients. The brewing process of native Dutch mead showcases the miracles of nature, creating one of the oldest alcoholic beverages on Earth without human intervention. This episode not only demonstrates the diversity and complexity of sweetness but also shows us that nature itself is the greatest brewer, reminding us to return to nature and enjoy the pure sweetness in life.

A fairytale patisserie in Copenhagen, Denmark... A traditional maple sugar shack in Canada... And the sweet taste of home in Fuzhou... Cakes, maple syrup and taro puree tell a story of inheritance, memory and innovation in different parts of the world. They demonstrate how food can become a symbol of cultural identity and family heritage. As Xiaoyang, a young women from Fuzhou, China, says: even something as simple as taro puree has deep cultural roots and carries warm family memories, reminding us that respect for tradition is lasting.

Sweet Migration serves up three unique stories, about: a family restaurant in Harbin serving a dish that's a unique fusion of southern and northern Chinese cuisines: a French bakery in Tierra del Fuego, Argentina; and a well-known donut shop in New York. As people move from city to city and country to country, they spread their culinary cultures. The program reveals the unique attraction of sweet food that allows it to transcend geographical boundaries to become a bond shared worldwide, a form of cultural expression, and a means of heritage prevention.

Dr. Lisa is given the job of finding a new family member for Cade and Matthew, still grieving the loss of their beautiful dog, Callie. They want to find a new dog to join their family and help them heal the hurt.
Tonight, the contestants must create the ultimate kids party cake. Adriano Zumbo and Rachel Khoo won't be the only judges; they've called in some tough critics - kids!

Well known as the headquarters for generations of crime bosses, Carlton was also the epicentre of a creative outpouring in the 1960s and 70s that led to the emergence of a uniquely Australian film and theatre culture.

In 1941 sleepy, tropical Brisbane found itself the nerve centre for the Pacific War effort. The former convict colony found itself changing quickly, yet politically Queensland is the most conservative state in Australia.

p.t: The Wild Life of Tim Faulkner
p.d: Tim and longtime friend and fellow Reptile Park worker Obi put their lives on the line all in the name of love as they enter the cassowary enclosure. A call out to a local factory ends in another Peregrine Falcon rescue for Tim.

p.t: The Wild Life of Tim Faulkner
p.d: In the NT Tim visits Kakadu and then a wildlife park dedicated to crocodiles. Back at the reptile park Cameron the cormorant’s life is on the line after swallowing discarded litter and Tim introduces an array of amphibians.

The major port of Australia’s remote west coast, Fremantle began life as a place of punishment. But the ethnically diverse port city has since been the sight of some of Australia’s greatest triumphs… and disappointments.
The real story of Melbourne isn’t found in the grand tree-lined boulevards or boomtown architecture. It’s hidden down the lanes and alleyways.

p.t: The Wild Life of Tim Faulkner
p.d: Tim visits his mate Milton in the Northern Territory to help relocate a problem croc, then back home microchips baby wombats and koalas, weighs Betty the python and then heads into the bush to check on the health of some platypus.

p.t: The Wild Life of Tim Faulkner
p.d: Tim helps a friend move a 4-meter alligator from one pond to another, all in the name of love. He introduces us to one of his big passions, the Tasmanian Devil, and later, back at the park, extracts venom from snakes and spiders.
Chris and Lisa head to fire-ravaged Blue Mountains to help stranded animals. Chris treats a premature baby alpaca whose mum went into early labor during evacuation. The newborn cria is fading fast.

After their budget bowls club wedding unravels, the Norfolk Island community comes together to give a couple the ultimate budget wedding. In Queensland, a bride must choose between her dream reception and a visa to stay in Australia.
Rick immerses himself in the northwest's food traditions at Britain's best market, enjoys memories of Manchester's music scene and cooks an old favourite: liver, bacon and onions.

p.t: Eat Well For Less New Zealand
p.d: Tight knit whanau (Family) try to keep to a strict budget but their dream of a trip to Samoa to reconnect with family still feels out of reach.
In Spring Week, the remaining bakers take on Cupcake Bouquets, a Raspberry Pavlova, and a Showstopper Tart Within a Tart.
The chefs make a dish worthy of a high-end restaurant that shows off their creativity and technique, but they won't be cooking these dishes themselves.
The fifth and final qualifying round arrives at a fort overlooking views of Canada's Atlantic coast. Cake makers travel with cakes in hand to show off their proudest creations.
Paul learns how to forage for seaside food from a friend but it's not for free and he faces a chef style challenge.
The Bikers start their adventure in south Wales, hunting for unique ingredients to include on the menu of a family restaurant that has its eyes on winning a Michelin star.

The team unearth secrets of supermarkets. Kate investigates soaring demand for online orders. Matt uncovers the secrets to ready meals. Andi finds out what supermarkets are doing to tackle food waste.
In the Signature Bake Challenge, contestants bake All American Pie, then face a Technical Bake with missing instructions, followed by 36 sweet tartlets.
Jeremy hopes to prove that Asian cooking can be simple and perfect for a midweek meal. He starts with Steamed Salmon with chilli bean, garlic and ginger oil, a fresh and delicious supper.
Sisters Lynne and Samantha, who spent childhood holidays in Spain, share the dream of buying a property together for family getaways.

p.t: A Place In The Sun: What Happened Next?
p.d: Our property experts catch up with house-hunters who bought their perfect place abroad, and get a glimpse of what their lives are like living in the sun.

p.t: I Bought It At Auction With Sarah Beeny

p.d: Single mum sisters Kristin and Michelle join forces to buy a home. Jonathan and Drew help them balance budgets, opinions and shared living.
Drew must make some hard budget decisions with his ensuite bathroom. Meanwhile Jonathan runs into a renovation snag that could lose him this challenge, as well as the whole competition.

Dave and Jenny purchase an '80's ranch in an up-and-coming neighbourhood to turn it into an amazing rental property; with their own money on the line, the Mars are up against a tight budget and timeline as they push toward their open house.
Kirstie and Phil help two Glasgow couples find dream homes. Adam and Alexandra have been searching for months, while Emma and Jon face a shock in their search.
Firefighter Justin and wife Deborah seek a 250,000 pound property after two years of searching. They need Phil's help to find their dream home.
Ben and Sophie need a home in Godalming with 480,000 pounds. Meanwhile, Glen and Rachel discover 250,000 pounds doesn't go far in Guildford.

p.t: A Place In The Sun: What Happened Next?
p.d: Our property experts catch up with house-hunters who bought their perfect place abroad, and get a glimpse of what their lives are like living in the sun.
Emotions run high as realtors and their clients leave their milieu to look for new properties abroad.
Dave and Jenny travel to Italy to take on their biggest project yet, helping friends who've poured their life savings into a Tuscan farmhouse rental.

p.t: Love It Or List It Vancouver
p.d: Karalyn and Todd's 1960's house needs more than a reno. Jillian must radically redesign the entire layout to keep Karalyn at home, while Todd tries to tempt them with a new house.
Shane and Sydney want to leave his bachelor pad behind. Drew and Jonathan devise a plan to enhance its value for a family-friendly move.
Wildly social and tired of being crammed in a tiny apartment, Olivia is desperate to buy her ideal property so seeks the advice of experts Drew and Jonathan Scott.
From extreme hoarders to design battles, the team swap war stories and principles as they revisit some of the toughest homes they have faced.

Rob and Robyn have spent more than a decade trying to sell their property. Now that Rob has been diagnosed with prostate cancer, they're even more desperate to get a sale so they can move forward with their lives.
Today the crews cope with a reported stabbing and help a man who was run over by his own car. They visit a woman suffering a panic attack and attend a man in agony from a dislocated hip.
Kin (65), who has Motor Neurone Disease, is rushed in with suspected sepsis, whilst Steve (57) has amputated 3 of his fingers on a power tool. Jordan (19) has been injured in a recent car crash.
In the rugged Dales of North Yorkshire, body cameras and airborne fixed-rigs offer full access to the adrenaline-packed medical rescue missions of the Yorkshire Air Ambulance.
In County Durham, heli-medics battle to keep Mick alive after a massive seizure; twelve-year-old Ollie faces a limb-threatening injury at the motocross track.

Paramedics respond to reports of a patient in cardiac arrest. When they arrive, there's no answer at the door. A few miles away, a PE lesson at school ends abruptly when a young boy has an epileptic seizure.
Tucci discovers the history of beautiful and troubled Calabria, as well as the history of his own family; joined by his parents, he reflects on the inspiration people draw from Calabria.

At a clinic in the Yorkshire countryside, activist Jono Lancaster and a team of doctors come together to help provide care, free of charge, to people who society treats differently because of the way they look.
It's the semi-final as Siobhan McSweeney hosts Bathroom Week, but will the potters be left feeling calm after making Turkish Baths style twin sinks and decorative tiles?
From extreme hoarders to design battles, the team swap war stories and principles as they revisit some of the toughest homes they have faced.

This series travels the country bringing together in each location specialists in antiques and fine arts to have them appraise items brought in by local residents.
Charlie Ross heads to Southwell in Nottinghamshire, where experts Mark Stacey and Steph Connell are on hand to guide the teams around the antiques stalls.
David and Hettie's second outing, featuring a Mercedes 280 SL and several Scottish cows.

Follow four families of four different species - the resourceful Beach Troop, the warlike Desert Troop, the disciplined River Troop, and the peaceful Mountain Band - to find out why these primates are among the most successful animals in Africa.

As the dry season approaches, tensions rise on Lemur Island, both between rival gangs and within their own ranks. Get a view from the battlefield as the female leaders fiercely defend their turf, while their newborn infants cling to them for safety.

As food and water become scarce, Crystal, the fierce leader of the Ruins gang, sets her sights on rival Kati's territory and its neighboring fruit trees. Watch as Crystal's move and a raid by outside invaders lead to dire consequences for one troop.

The drought is finally over, but traversing the forest for food is still a gamble. See some leaders take the risk, leaving home territories undefended to feast on a cicada boom. When they return, trespassers are ready for a fight.

As the babies grow, new power struggles break out in each troop. Watch as every member, from fierce Queen Crystal to low-ranking Erica, jockeys for position. Meanwhile, the babies start to understand how allies and enemies will shape their future.

The pressure to find food reaches new heights and throws the reserve into turmoil. Witness fractures emerge within the ranks, dividing the gangs and leading Crystal, the indomitable leader of the Ruins gang, to face a challenge like none before.

Marvel at the clever ways predators use cunning, agility, and breakneck speed when taking down prey. Witness luring behaviours and see how some killers hide in plain sight, while others put weaponry or chemical warfare to work to bring dinner home.

A curious raccoon sticks his head a little too far into a peanut butter jar on a sweltering summer day in Toronto. See how the team gets him out of this sticky situation. Then cheer on a painted turtle who needs emergency eye surgery.

Monsoon storms sweep over the tropical island of Sri Lanka, and water carried in with swirling mists hits the mountainous heartland, beginning a journey through the many changing faces of the island's forests.

Meet a cat whose raging hormones are driving her mad. Can Dr. Scott help her keep her frisky tendencies in check? Later, head to Sheffield to meet a teen animal activist, and tag along on an impromptu house call for a badly behaved meerkat.

Say hello to Lucy and Mike, a pair of mangrove monitor lizard cagemates whose spat has landed them in the ER: her with gaping wounds and him in need of an urgent manicure. Then cheer as a tree snake and an echidna narrowly escape tragic fates.
Chris and Lisa head to fire-ravaged Blue Mountains to help stranded animals. Chris treats a premature baby alpaca whose mum went into early labour during evacuation. The newborn cria is fading fast.

Meet a rescue dog who needs Dr. Chris’s expertise when troubling tumours are diagnosed. Then watch Dr. Lisa treat a canine patient with extremely painful swelling, and check out a scary snapping turtle terrorizing keepers at a reptile park.
Dr Chris meets a Lemur who's left canine tooth has darkened and are concerned it is an infection that could become a major problem for the small Lemur, especially as they suspect she may be pregnant.

Dr Chris has received a call from Tim Faulkner at the Australian Reptile Park. One of the parks kangaroos has a nasty lump under its chin and Chris needs to make an emergency dash to the park to perform an urgent operation, that is made more difficult as the Roo is a mother with young joey.

“It doesn’t get much better than this” is one of the first things that Dr Chris says when a 4-week-old baby lion cub Zambi is brought into the Bondi Clinic. For safety reasons Zambi has had to be removed from her mother by carers Donna and Mandy from the animal welfare organization LOTL (Life On The Line) Rescue. Not only does the young lion require a medical check-up but she also needs a surrogate mother and Dr Chris has the perfect – while very strange solution. No one is sure if it will work.

The rehabilitation staff turns their attention to two beavers who suddenly find themselves in need of emergency lodging; a volunteer decides to give an in-depth, personal look at what life is like inside the rehabilitation centre.

Travel to the Cook Islands as Chris helps out at a vet clinic where ill and injured pets abound. Princess needs help following a hit and run, and Mani the duck has lost a fight. A goat and a wolfhound round out the medical menagerie.

Observe Chris on a busy day at a vet clinic in the Cook Islands. Small One's first patient is a cat. Border collie Rocket isn’t feeling too swift after gorging on a batch of bread dough, and Bluey, a 5-metre croc, needs to be moved.

Rosa, a rescued Stattfordshire terrier, receives treatment from Dr. Scott; a gardener arrives at the clinic with a parakeet suffering from a broken leg; Dr. Scott comes to the rescue when his new puppy, Skully, has an accident.

Inspect a host of tiny creatures with big problems. Check out a pile of lumps and bumps that challenge the vets, who’ve been called on to help a tiny zebra finch, a green tree frog, a turtle named Squirtle, and a guinea pig with a sore tooth.

Adam and Jamie, and Kari, Grant and Tory all burn rubber in more ways than one! So buckle up because this is going to be a bumpy ride!

Special effects experts Adam and Jamie use several experiments to put an old Hollywood lighting myth to the test; Tory, Kari and Grant experiment with different ways that someone could stop cars that have gone out of control.
In Depth Charge Disaster Adam and Jamie are exploring the physics of shock waves in water and, if you're nearby, how best to avoid injury.
Adam and Jamie get swinging for science. Kari, Tory and Grant investigate a classic Hollywood-meets-physics conundrum.

Join our gun-toting trio first at the bomb range where they re-create a car crash by dropping a car 150 feet from a crane onto another car buried in the ground with 50 pounds of high explosives in the trunk..
Adam and Jamie test the myth that a motorcycle is a greener and cleaner machine than a car. Meanwhile, Kari Tory and Grant unleash the first RPG in MythBusters history.

In this explosive episode of MythBusters, Jamie and Adam tackle a military myth that it’s safe to use C4 as a cooking fuel as long as you don’t drop anything on it. Meanwhile Kari Grant and Tory put a Chinese martial arts myth to the test.

First up Adam and Jamie tackle three extraordinary viral videos of Exuberant Excavators. Kari, Grant and Tory, take the team’s favourite tacky tape to it’s high flying limits in a tale from the wild Northwest.

On this scatological episode of MythBusters, Adam and Jamie get down and dirty to test a drain disaster, while Kari Tory and Grant break out the attack dogs, rev the hot rod and prime the explosives for three times the destruction.

The mailbox is full and the team once again leapt into action. To determine the lucky winners of the viewer request lottery the guys spin the Wheel of Mythfortune and pick five random emails and letters and respond the only way they know how with science.
Adam Savage and Jamie Hyneman reunite to reflect on their adventures on Duct Tape Island, using only the legendary tape to survive and provide a means of rescue. (Final)
On this episode of MythBusters, Adam and Jamie take on a blockbuster bath-bomb, while Kari, Tory and Grant take to the skies for a flock formation investigation.
In this controversial episode, the Mythbusters pit Men against Women in the ultimate Battle of the Sexes. Get set for all-out war as the team tests five age-old gender-based cliches.
Adam and Jamie reinvent the wheel, while Kari, Tory, and Grant hit the skids for a date night with a difference.

On this explosive episode MythBusters, it's Revenge of the Myths as the whole team gets together to take fan favourites to another level in the ultimate experimental ramp up. With cannons, fireworks, excavators and exploding limousines, if you want spectacle, this show has it in spades.

The gelada is a rare monkey that lives in the Simien Mountains of Ethiopia. They’re charismatic, vocal, and mix affection and confrontation. Watch as they face the challenges of their habitat—and each other.

Enter the wilds of South Africa to get an intimate look into one of the continent’s most misunderstood primates. Like humans, these primates have unique personalities and share strong bonds with their families and friends.

As humans take up more space, the baboons of Africa must adapt. Travel across the continent to watch them form unbreakable social bonds, serve to protect their families and survive a changing landscape.

Africa - a continent teeming with life. While its animal aristocrats are the most familiar, lurking in the shadows is a diversity of reptiles. They’ve conquered just about every habitat and have evolved a remarkable array of adaptations that make them the undisputed masters of the underworld.
The Belize Barrier Reef is part of the Mesoamerican Reef System, which stretches for approximately 700 miles from Mexico's Yucatan Peninsula to Honduras and Guatemala.
The island of Cozumel is a dazzling haven for marine life, less than 20 miles off the eastern coast of Mexico's Yucatan peninsula.
Home to the world's second-largest barrier reef, Roatan is one of the world's top dive spots known for its technicolour corals, Caribbean reef sharks, amazing octopus and invasive Lionfish.
Swaziland is one of Africa's smallest countries, but its wildlife rivals anywhere on Earth. See how the 'Big Five' and 132 mammal species have made it their home.

Explore a region that provides shelter to a wide array of life, despite its harsh conditions. Whether burrows of nocturnal bat-eared foxes or massive colonies of harvester ants, this ecosystem offers a wealth of resources to its native wildlife.
Tanzania's vast Ngorongoro Crater is in many ways a perfect home for wildlife. However, its isolation also threatens their futures.

From the vast, dry plains of the interior come some of Australia’s most recognised imagery, such as the monolithic red rock of Uluru and the bounding red kangaroo. But how did the arid centre of the continent come to be?
At the southern edge of the Pantanal, the world's largest tropical wetland on Earth, there's a place like no other, and a wildlife so diverse scientists scramble to understand it.
Insects are a virtually unlimited food source for cunning predators. Discover the highly developed skills of dragonflies, scorpions, Venus flytraps, and more.
Witness the deadly hunting techniques of nature’s specialised killing machines.
This is the story of the African penguins' daily struggle to raise families in an unforgiving and often hostile environment.
When a young Army medic based at Ft. Bragg, N.C., goes missing, police can't solve the case despite having a suspect until an unorthodox private investigator steps in to help.
When a young woman fails to show up to work and her mother rushes to her home to try to find her, what she discovers begins an investigation that leads to a suspect no one imagined.
A Pennsylvania mother disappears after co-workers see her leave for lunch.
When Ohio mother Heather Bogle goes missing, a detective identifies multiple suspects, until he himself comes under scrutiny for his investigation.
Two double homicides committed five years apart lead police to suspect a serial killer is responsible.

Sharp conversational coverage of the week's news, along with in-depth profiles of the people and personalities shaping American culture, assessing the highs and lows of the week and looking ahead to the next one.
Interviews with public figures and those making news, setting the political agenda and spotlighting the impact Washington decision-making has on Americans.

When a woman experiences a slew of admirers, she is suddenly found dead in a fire that consumed her home, but when police search for clues regarding the truth behind the death, they start to realize that the fire was no accident.
When one woman breaks off her relationship with a boyfriend she says abused and stalked her, he moves on to something even worse.
Lester Holt spends two nights locked up and embedded inside the largest maximum security prison in America, the notorious Louisiana State Penitentiary, also known as Angola.
A man disappears after a duck hunting trip in Florida on his sixth wedding anniversary and is later found to have been murdered.
A murder case considered closed by North Dakota detectives is suddenly reopened when a confidential informant comes forward with a tip about an unlikely suspect.

A look at the case of con man John Meehan, including interviews with his wife and her daughter, his ex-wife, law enforcement officers, and the Los Angeles Times reporter who shined a spotlight on the story.
The battle between a wife and a mistress for one man's heart leads to a deadly car chase.
The mysterious death of a young mother in Ohio and the ensuing investigation that spans years and multiple states.
Find out who wins $100,000 for their kitchen in judging.
Queen of comedy Magda Szubanski sits down with Tracy Grimshaw in her first major interview since her bombshell cancer diagnosis. Plus, surfing legend Mick Fanning on how he turned loss into strength.
Join the 9News Late team for all of today's top stories from Australia and around the world.
When three people are gunned down in a quiet neighbourhood, Gwinnette County police struggle to find a connection between the victims.

A young, pregnant woman is found dead of an apparent suicide in Saginaw, MI, but her family and friends don't believe it. As police dig deep to get to the truth, they discover a shocking secret they never saw coming.

Part one of three. Cost-conscious Senator Kinsey vows to shut down the Stargate project, riding roughshod over Daniel's objections and contemptuously dismissing the danger of an imminent attack by the Goa'uld. Richard Dean Anderson stars.

To stop the Goa'uld invasion, the SG-1 team disobeys orders and transports itself to the Goa'uld attack headquarters. Landing amidst preparations for an all-out strike on Earth, the way home is blocked. Can the team avert disaster and save humanity?

As a fleet of Goa'uld warships heads toward Earth, threatening to destroy it, the Stargate facility prepares for the worst, sending the best and brightest of American society through the Stargate to a safe Alpha site.

On a daring mission to rescue victims of an interplanetary attack, Carter's body is inhabited by a Goa'uld. And now that Carter has brought the demon back to Earth inside her, the SG-1 team must find a way to destroy it....without destroying Carter!
While exploring a seemingly insignificant planet, Col. Jack O'Neill and the SG-1 team are approached by a ragged figure who pleads for their help from a pursuer named Taldor.

While investigating an unknown planet, the SG-1 team discovers enigmatic structures that appear to contain various unconscious people; after being captured, the team is forced to relive painful memories from their pasts.

Daniel finds himself becoming increasingly involved in a romance with the stunningly attractive Princess of an alien civilization, and he finds that his newfound situation has granted him the chance to save the SG-1 from a harrowing fate.
The SG-1 team travel to the planet of Cimmeria to protect it from a massive Goa'uld attack.

While exploring a now-dead planet, Col. Jack O'Neill and the SG-1 team find an orb that sends out electromagnetic signals. They think it is a time capsule of some sort and are intrigued by its power source, which seems to have lasted a millennium.

SG-1 goes on a mission to rescue Teal'c's son, Rya'c, from the grasp of Apophis. But, when they finally reach Rya'c, he doesn't want to be saved -- he's been brainwashed and has accepted Apophis as his god! Can Teal'c find a way to win back his son?
Daniel Jackson learns that his wife is pregnant with Apophis' child and O'Neill discovers that a reporter is ready to blow the lid off the top-secret Stargate project.

O'Neill and the team are attacked by giant insects while exploring a new planet and try to retreat through the Stargate, but Teal'c is stung before they can escape. Once back at the SGC, he begins to undergo a terrifying transformation. Sci-fi drama, starring Christopher Judge and Richard Dean Anderson

Using coordinates that Carter found in a dream, SG-1 contacts the Tok'ra with the hope of creating an alliance against the Goa'uld System Lords; Dr. Carter is informed of her father's debilitating health due to lymphoma.

The Tok'ra are desperate for hosts so they can continue fighting the Goa'uld. Carter's father, who is dying of cancer, has nothing to lose by volunteering his body. But will he die during the transference...or does fate have something else in store?

The SG-11 team has not returned from its mission to planet PXY-887, where they recently discovered an element, Trinium, that is a hundred times lighter and stronger than steel. Instead, the inhabitants of the planet have fired an arrow made of Trinium through the Stargate and into the shoulder of Jack O'Neill.

Captain Dave Carraro’s alliance with Captain TJ Ott is put to the test when he discovers the bite is on, and there’s only one other boat in the vicinity. And Captain Pete Speeches heads back to Maine to try and turn his luck around, while things finally start to pick up for Captain Dave Marciano.
It's week four of the North Atlantic bluefin tuna season and tensions start to boil for Wicked Pissah's new crew, while two rival harpoon boats face off.

As the Gloucester captains charge into week five of the North Atlantic bluefin fishing season, teamwork becomes more and more important to a skipper's prospects. Everything will come down to whether a captain can count on his crew. But this week, the grind of fishing catches up to many crewmembers, forcing some captains to rethink their strategies for their season.

With no luck catching a fish after his crew quit, Paul is forced to accept help from one of the rival teams. For one week, Geordie is working on the Wicked Pissah alongside Paul. Eventually, Paul begins thinking of making the arrangement permanent. With his reputation as being hard to work for, can Paul make this work, or will he have to post another “Help Wanted” sign?

Things begin to look up for Paul when his crew decides to give him another chance. Pete begins noticing that his daughter is not pulling her weight on the boat. Could this be the cause of his last-place position? To make matters worse, an argument between Dave and Tyler escalates, leaving one of the golden rules of fishing broken, and tensions and allegations flying.

At just past the halfway mark of the North Atlantic bluefin tuna season some teams are working well together and killing it while others are floundering and on the verge of killing each other. Hard Merchandise leads the fleet with FV-Tuna trailing in its wake. Last place Captain Tyler McLaughlin of Pinwheel is determined to move up but his mates' class warfare could thwart his plan. Wicked Pissa's newly reunited crew aim to prove they can take down FV-Tuna.com.

The Gloucester fleet captains all face a familiar decision: whether or not to take the long, high-risk journey to Georges Bank to increase their chances of a big bluefin haul or possibly come home empty-handed. Steaming out to Georges is a huge gamble - expenses can range into the thousands of dollars and out on the water nothing is guaranteed. Who will test the deep waters of the legendary, far-off Georges Bank and who will play it safe? And which choice will pay off?

After a massive haul offshore on Georges Bank last week, Captain Dave Carraro of FV-Tuna.com and Captain TJ Ott of Hot Tuna decide to double down and make the long trip again in hopes of another massive payday. However, Captain Dave Marciano chooses to keep Hard Merchandise inshore despite FV-Tuna.com’s recent success that has put them back on top of the fleet.

When a violent storm rolls in during week 11, the Gloucester captains face a tough decision at a critical time: Do they fish … or flee? Captains Dave Marciano of the Hard Merchandise and Dave Carraro of FV-Tuna.com both feel that braving the weather is a risk worth taking, as the rolling seas may well bring the bite to the surface.
With four weeks left in the season, Hard Merchandise and FV-¬- Tuna.Com struggle to stay at the top of the fleet as an unexpected adversary, the Wicked Pissah.

With only three weeks left, the North Atlantic captains face more competition than ever as boats from all over head to Gloucester and battle for those last bluefin of the season. The bite is hot inshore, forcing captains into a turf war with the competition and each other. Extra lines in the water make landing a tuna, not to mention a paycheck, the ultimate challenge for the fleet.

With a narrow margin separating the top four boats and only two weeks left in the season, Captain Ott of Hot Tuna must catch up, while Captain Marciano of Hard Merchandise wants to hold the lead. Captain Carraro risks breaking his season-long streak.

In the last week of the Atlantic bluefin tuna season the closest race in Wicked Tuna history is a tossup between four top contenders - Hot Tuna, Hard Merchandise, FV-Tuna.com and Wicked Pissah - and it will all come down to the final catch! With high-value bluefin paying off at up to $16,000, the leading captains are all one fish away from victory or defeat. And Pinwheel Captain Tyler McLaughlin is desperate for a big score to get him back in the game.

It's the opening week of a new North Atlantic Bluefin tuna season, and for the fishermen of Gloucester, Massachusetts, the summer ahead promises the chance for big fortunes. But fishing for tuna is a gamble and captains and their crews but battle old rivals, new competitors and each other in what will be the most challenging season yet.
After every boat, except the Wicked Pissah, caught fish during the first week, all eyes are on Paul Hebert.
